lines.text: The sons of Korah recall that God drove out the nations with His hand and planted their fathers in the land.
The psalmist says he does not trust in his spear, and God saves them from their enemies.
God rejected and humbled them, and they retreated from the foe, and He sold His people for nothing.
They had not forgotten God or betrayed His covenant, yet He crushed them in the lair of lions.
The psalmist cries for God to wake up, and asks Him to redeem them on account of His loving devotion.
